# copart-api-examples

> Code examples (curl, Python, JavaScript, PHP) for reading Copart auction lots (USA) through apiauto.space, a read-only REST API. Base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1, header X-API-Key, market=us. A free one-day demo key (100 requests) comes from the Telegram bot https://t.me/apiautospace_bot?start=demo. Not affiliated with Copart.

Key facts:

- Copart lots live in `market=us` together with IAAI lots. The API has no auction filter: a `source` query parameter is ignored. Keep records where `source` is `copart`; in the change feed keep events whose `car_id` starts with `copart:`. Record ids look like `copart:70370576`. A page can hold no Copart lots at all: walk `next_cursor`; `sort=first_seen` wasted the fewest records on 2 November 2026 (it is no contract).
- Paid plans count every returned lot, including lots of the other auction; the demo counts data requests.
- Endpoints: GET /v1/cars (filters brand, model, trim, year_min, year_max, price_min, price_max, price_usd_min, price_usd_max, mileage_max, fuel, transmission, body_type, has_photos, is_active, q; sort; cursor pagination; limit up to 100, 20 on the demo), GET /v1/cars/{id}, GET /v1/changes (added, disappeared, price_drop, price_up since a moment), GET /v1/references/{brands,models,dictionaries,markets}, GET /v1/usage.
- Auction fields are in `raw`: lot_number, damage_main, damage_second, title_doc, bid, buy_now, sale_date, odometer_mi, keys_available, location_branch. `price` is the buy-now price or null; `listing_url` is null for US lots.
- Server-side only: CORS is off.
- Client libraries: `pip install apiauto-space` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-python), `npm i apiauto` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-js), `composer require apiauto/apiauto` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-php), `go get github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-go` (https://github.com/apiauto-space/apiauto-go).
